en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style cityscape showing a fortified medieval town built on a river bend. Dominating the scene is a tall round stone tower with crenellations and a lower rectangular gate tower at its base, integrated into old city walls. Behind and around it rise steep-roofed houses and several church towers and spires with crosses, characteristic of a historic Central European town. A small bridge crosses the river in the foreground, and the overall view is taken from an elevated vantage point, capturing much of the old town.
